sections.title: The sales team

sections.title: Mailbox
sections.description: The shared team mailbox the agent sends reviewed follow-ups and proposals from, and reads replies in.

blocks.markdown: Without a connected mailbox, nothing is blocked: follow-ups and proposals are prepared as drafts and a person sends them.
